gcp.secretmanager.access.note: Access operations per 10,000 (https://cloud.google.com/secret-manager/pricing). One SKU for every location; it is not listed under "global", so sync reads it in us-central1. The price list's first tier is a free grant, billed here at the first paid tier's price.

gcp.secretmanager.versions.note: Active secret version per location; automatic replication counts as one location (https://cloud.google.com/secret-manager/pricing). The catalog prices a version-month ($0.06), 730 version-hours. The price list's first tier is a free grant, billed here at the first paid tier's price.
